step G83 of the content expansion, Bulletproof, Rivalry, Leaf Guard and Iron Ball (decision 0015 entry 5bt), all four engine rows read by id (Bulletproof in dfi_try_hit_abilities; Rivalry in the base power chain; Leaf Guard in dfi_try_status and dfi_yawn; Iron Ball in dfi_grounded and the item chain of dfi_speed_key): the marks and the bullet bit of the flags3 column, and each of the eight battles of its list replays to its end; test_conformance compares the lines and HP of every step.

Split by subject from the test of step G83 (restructure step 6e; tests/renames.tsv maps the old name).

step G83 of the content expansion (decision 0015 entry 5bt), Mega Sol and Leaf Guard, reached through Trace: Gardevoir (Trace, not Grass) copies Leaf Guard from the Meganium foe, and a Mega Meganium (Mega Sol) uses Poison Powder on her in no sun. The pin's Leaf Guard reads Pokemon#effectiveWeather of the target, which is sun for the user's move (sim/pokemon.ts:2193), and refuses the poison; the engine does not model that, so over 16 seeds the step returns DUOFORGE_E_UNSUPPORTED in some of them (Poison Powder's 75% accuracy, and Trace copies only when Meganium is on the field first). The control, the same battle with no Mega evolution, plays every seed with no refusal.
